source.author: verg
source.text: Sed fugit interea, fugit irreparabile tempus, singula dum capti circumvectamur amore.
source.text_original: Sed fugit interea, fugit irreparabile tempus, / singula dum capti circumvectamur amore.
source.text_english: But meanwhile it flees, irretrievable time flees, while, enthralled by love, we wander round each detail.
